steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass', then confirm you are logged in (e.g. the dashboard loads and the admin user is shown). Report what you see.

02-report: Navigate to the Opportunities list view. Report the names of every opportunity whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen (list all of them, in order). Do not modify anything.

03-create: Create a new Opportunity record with these values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account = 'Bench Account' (this is a link field — type it and actually pick the 'Bench Account' record from the suggestions dropdown so it is attached, do not just leave typed text); Description containing the text '{{runid}}'; Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500; Close Date = 2026-12-31; Assigned User = 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — pick the actual user record from the suggestions, do not leave plain typed text). Save the record. Then open the saved record's own page and report exactly what is displayed for: name, account, stage, amount, close date, assigned user, and description.

04-verify: On the opportunity record page for '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' ({{03-create.url}}), I need to verify the exact stored value of the Close Date field, including the year. Click the pencil/edit icon on the Close Date field to open it for in-place editing, and report the exact value shown in the date input box (it should be a full date with year, e.g. 2026-12-31). If it is NOT 2026-12-31, change it to 2026-12-31 and save. Then close/cancel the in-place editor without breaking anything, and report the final exact value of the close date input and whether you had to change it.

05-find: On the opportunity record page for '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' ({{03-create.url}}), find the Stream panel and post a new message whose text includes '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Bench note {{runid}} — opportunity created for the bench run'). Submit the post so it appears in the stream, then report the exact text of the post as it is displayed in the stream, and confirm it is visible on the page.

06-open: Open the opportunity record page at {{03-create.url}} fresh (reload it) and verify all of the following, reporting the exact on-screen values: (1) the record's Name; (2) the Account it is linked to; (3) the Stage; (4) the Amount including currency symbol; (5) the Assigned User; (6) the Description text; (7) that the Stream panel contains a post whose text includes '{{runid}}'; (8) the exact record ID as it appears in the page address/URL. Do not change anything — this is a read-only verification.
07-report: Go to the Opportunities list view and report the full list of opportunity names shown, in order, and the total record count. Read-only, do not modify anything.
